notes.title: Haunted Stories is now available!
notes.notes:
Dear community,

the game "Haunted Stories" is now available. I would like to point out that I focus on the first three maps in order to be able to react quickly in the event of errors.
If you find any errors, please report these errors to my discord server.
[url=https://discord.gg/n5nYpyE4][b]DISCOD SERVER HAUNTED STORIES[/b][/url]

It is also possible to express your opinion under discussions. What do you like about Haunted Stories? What can be improved?

I hope you enjoy the game and wish everyone a lot of fun playing! ːsteamhappyː
